package occurrences_test

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json/v2"
 "io"
 "net/http"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "strings"
 "sync/atomic"
 "testing"

 client "example.com/occurrences/gen/http/occurrences/client"
 server "example.com/occurrences/gen/http/occurrences/server"
 svc "example.com/occurrences/gen/occurrences"
 loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestOccurrenceContracts(t *testing.T) {
 var calls atomic.Int32
 echo := func(_ context.Context, value any) (any, error) {
  calls.Add(1)
  return value, nil
 }
 mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
 server.Mount(mux, server.New(&svc.Endpoints{
  Base: echo, Left: echo, Right: echo, Occurrences: echo, Deferred: echo,
 }, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
 host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
 defer host.Close()
 c := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(host.URL, "http://"), host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
 for _, tc := range []struct {
  name, wire string
  payload any
  call func(context.Context, any) (any, error)
 }{
  {"base", `{"id":""}`, new(svc.Base), c.Base()},
  {"left", `{"id":"","left":""}`, new(svc.Left), c.Left()},
  {"right", `{"id":"","right":""}`, new(svc.Right), c.Right()},
  {"occurrences", `{"direct":{"id":"","left":""},"list":[{"id":"","right":""}],"index":{"x":{"id":"","left":""}}}`, new(svc.Occurrences), c.Occurrences()},
  {"deferred", `{}`, new(svc.Deferred), c.Deferred()},
  {"deferred child", `{"child":{"name":""}}`, new(svc.Deferred), c.Deferred()},
 } {
  t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(tc.wire), tc.payload))
   before := calls.Load()
   result, err := tc.call(t.Context(), tc.payload)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.Equal(t, before+1, calls.Load())
   require.Equal(t, tc.payload, result)
   output, err := json.Marshal(result, json.Deterministic(true))
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.JSONEq(t, tc.wire, string(output))
  })
 }
 for _, tc := range []struct{
  name, wire, missing string
 }{
  {"base", `{}`, "id"},
  {"left", `{"id":""}`, "left"},
  {"right", `{"id":""}`, "right"},
  {"occurrences", `{"direct":{"id":""},"list":[],"index":{}}`, "left"},
  {"occurrences", `{"direct":{"id":"","left":""},"list":[{"id":""}],"index":{}}`, "right"},
  {"occurrences", `{"direct":{"id":"","left":""},"list":[],"index":{"x":{"id":""}}}`, "left"},
  {"deferred", `{"child":{}}`, "name"},
 } {
  t.Run("reject "+tc.name+tc.wire, func(t *testing.T) {
   before := calls.Load()
   response, err := host.Client().Post(host.URL+"/"+tc.name, "application/json", strings.NewReader(tc.wire))
   require.NoError(t, err)
   raw, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
   require.NoError(t, err)
   require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
   require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, response.StatusCode, string(raw))
   require.Contains(t, string(raw), `"code":"missing_field"`)
   require.Contains(t, string(raw), "Missing required field: "+tc.missing)
   require.Equal(t, before, calls.Load())
  })
 }
}
